content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati), Research & Development Section has announced 1 vacancy for the Assistant Project Engineer post on a project-based nature of engagement with an 11 months duration of appointment. Candidates holding a Bachelor`s degree in Engineering/Design can apply online by visiting the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati on or before 26 October 2026 at 5:30 PM. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 28,500. The selection process consists of shortlisting based on qualifications followed by an online interview scheduled for 29 October 2026.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati)
Design and Development of a Demonstration Plant for Production of Marketable Grade Green Activated Carbon from Bamboo Dust
Rs. 28,500 per month with 18% HRA and Medical Facility
Application Last Date: 26 October 2026 (05:30 PM) / Interview Date: 29 October 2026

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential qualification stipulated for the Assistant Project Engineer position under the Department of Chemical Engineering project.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate for the Assistant Project Engineer post will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 28,500 per month. Additionally, 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA) and medical facility benefits are applicable as per the project terms. The duration of the appointment is 11 months. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer
content_sections.text: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati via the official recruitment link. Search for the project title "Design and Development of a Demonstration Plant for Production of Marketable Grade Green Activated Carbon from Bamboo Dust" to locate the relevant position. Carefully follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal. Complete and submit the online application on or before 26 October 2026 by 05:30 PM. For technical assistance related to the online application process, contact the support email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail about the online link of the interview. The interview is scheduled for 29 October 2026 at 10:00 am through an online mode (Google Meet/Teams). Application status can be checked directly from the application portal. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test or interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before the specified deadline of 26 October 2026 at 05:30 PM. Applicants must carefully follow all instructions and guidelines available on the recruitment portal. Shortlisted candidates will receive the online interview link via email. No Travelling Allowance (TA) or Dearness Allowance (DA) will be provided for attending the test or interview. For any clarification, candidates may contact Principal Investigator Prof. Senthilmurugan Subbiah via email at [email protected] or phone at +91 361 258 3527.
